主要内容: Asta Funding, Inc. received a Delinquency Compliance Plan Alert Letter from Nasdaq on February 16, 2018, indicating non-compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The company failed to file its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended December 31, 2017, and remained delinquent in filing its Form 10-K for the year ended September 30, 2017. Nasdaq granted the company until March 19, 2018, to submit a plan to regain compliance. If submitted, the company may have up to 180 calendar days from the Form 10-K due date, or until July 16, 2018, to meet requirements. The company plans to file the compliance plan by March 19, 2018, and expects to fully comply upon filing the Form 10-K and Form 10-Q as soon as reasonably practicable. On February 22, 2018, the company issued a press release announcing the receipt of the letter. A copy of the press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The company’s Chief Financial Officer, Bruce R. Foster, signed the report on February 22, 2018.
